senses.gloss: (= <he>לָא הִי</he>) = <cite ref="L00009"><he>לַאו</he></cite>. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 23 <he>הא לאי ביריא הוות</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="L00207"><he>לְווּ</he></cite>, read <cite ref="L00207"><he>לַוו</he></cite>) was this (the first tongs) not a divine creation?, i.e. it was nothing else than &c.; <cite ref="Pesachim 54a:7">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>הא ל׳ בריה בידי שמים היא</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 9 a. 10); <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 1:9">Tosef. Ḥag. I, 9</cite> <he>הא ל׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="A01770"><he>אלא</he></cite>, Var. <he>הא לוי</he> read: <cite ref="L00207"><he>לוו</he></cite>).—
units: Ker. 12ᵃ לאיי ה״נ לא עמדתי בטומאתי Ar. (ed. only ה״נ לא עמדתי) no; in this case, too, he may correct himself (saying), I did not remain &c. Ib. 6ᵇ לאיי מיצרך צריכי it is not so; they are necessary. Ib. ל׳ דכתיב וכ׳ it is not; for it is written &c.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 40b:4">Snh. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>לאיי אפנויי מופנה</he> it is not so; there is indeed an expression in the text open for interpretation; <cite ref="Shabbat 64a:17">Sabb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>לאי וכ׳</he> is it not? it is indeed &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 22b:13">Yoma 22ᵇ</cite> <he>ל׳ אפרעו מגופיה</he> no? Indeed, he was punished on his body.
